plugin-data.name: Podcast
plugin-data.description: Turns Bludit pages into a podcast – with episode management, podcast feed and Podlove Web Player.

podcast-texts.episodes-load-failed: The episodes could not be loaded. Details are in the Bludit log.
podcast-texts.settings-intro: Channel and feed settings of the podcast. Episodes are managed under {link}.
podcast-texts.author: Author
podcast-texts.cover-tip: Apple requires a square image of {min} to {max} px per side, JPG or PNG in RGB.
podcast-texts.cover-mismatch: The cover entered does not fit: {problems}
podcast-texts.cover-upload-tip: Checked on upload and entered as the cover URL; then click “Save”.
podcast-texts.url-ignored: Not used: the address must start with http:// or https://.
podcast-texts.category-tip: Apple uses the category for search and charts.
podcast-texts.category-invalid: The previous entry “{value}” is not an Apple category – please choose one. Until then, the feed has no category.
podcast-texts.show-type-serial: Serial – episodes in order, oldest first
podcast-texts.show-type-tip: Serial suits seasons meant to be heard from the start; then enter the season and episode number for each episode.
podcast-texts.feed-locked-tip: Yes: other platforms only take over the podcast once its ownership has been confirmed via the owner email ({tag}). Set to No before moving to another host.
podcast-texts.owner-email-tip: Published in the feed. Directories such as Apple Podcasts and Spotify use it to verify who owns the podcast.
podcast-texts.link-apple-tip: Links to the podcast appear in the player’s subscribe button (in the app: Share → Copy link). With the Apple link, Castro (iPhone) and Pocket Casts appear as well.
podcast-texts.link-pocketcasts-tip: Leave empty to connect Pocket Casts via the Apple link.
podcast-texts.link-ignored: Not used: the link does not have the expected form.
podcast-texts.feed-address-tip: Submit this address to Apple Podcasts, Spotify and other directories.
podcast-texts.podcast-guid-tip: Permanent identifier of the podcast ({tag}), generated from the feed address on the first save. It stays the same when the podcast moves.
podcast-texts.feed-url-tip: Only needed if the feed is served from a different address, e.g. a CDN. Leave empty for the address above.
podcast-texts.site-url-tip: Leave empty for this Bludit website.
podcast-texts.player-podlove: Podlove Web Player (self-hosted, no third parties)
podcast-texts.player-position-top: At the start of the content (below the title)
podcast-texts.player-position-bottom: At the end of the content
podcast-texts.player-position-tip: For a position of your own, write {placeholder} into the episode text.
podcast-texts.max-upload-tip: The server’s PHP limits apply as well.
podcast-texts.field-tip: Maintained by the podcast plugin (Admin → Podcast).
podcast-texts.title: Title
podcast-texts.audio-format-hint: Apple Podcasts does not play WAV and OGG files. For podcast directories, use MP3 or M4A instead.
podcast-texts.uploads-disabled: File uploads are disabled on the server ({setting}) – please use an audio URL.
podcast-texts.upload-limit-server: – limited by the server ({file}, {post}; plugin setting: {plugin} MB). For larger files, raise the PHP limits, see README.
podcast-texts.date-help: Website time zone: {timezone}. A future date schedules the episode.
podcast-texts.error-internal: Internal error. Details are in the Bludit log.
podcast-texts.error-post-too-large: Upload too large: the total size exceeds the server limit of {limit} MB. Please choose smaller files or use an audio URL.
podcast-texts.error-not-podcast: Page does not belong to the podcast
podcast-texts.error-fields-setup: The podcast fields could not be set up. Details are in the Bludit log.
podcast-texts.error-image-url: Image URL must start with http:// or https://
podcast-texts.error-audio-url: Audio URL must start with http:// or https://
podcast-texts.error-duration: Please enter the duration as HH:MM:SS, MM:SS or in seconds
podcast-texts.error-audio-required: An audio URL or file is required
podcast-texts.error-numbers: Episode and season must be whole numbers from 0
podcast-texts.error-save-failed: The episode could not be saved. Details are in the Bludit log.
podcast-texts.error-has-children: The episode has subpages and cannot be deleted here.
podcast-texts.error-delete-failed: The episode could not be deleted. Details are in the Bludit log.
podcast-texts.error-cover-admin-only: Only admins may change the cover.
podcast-texts.error-cover-unsuitable: The image is not suitable as a cover for Apple Podcasts: {problems} Required: square, {min} to {max} px, JPG or PNG in RGB.
podcast-texts.warning-length-unknown: Episode saved, but the file size of the audio URL could not be determined: {reason} The feed shows it as 0; it will be tried again on the next save.
podcast-texts.warning-image: Episode image saved, but it does not meet Apple’s requirements: {problems} Apple may then show only the channel cover.
podcast-texts.image-size-unreadable: The image size could not be read.
podcast-texts.image-cmyk: It is saved in the CMYK color space; Apple requires RGB.
podcast-texts.image-upload-ini-size: Image file too large (server limit: {limit}). Please choose a smaller file or use a URL.
podcast-texts.image-upload-form-size: Image file exceeds the form limit.
podcast-texts.image-upload-partial: Image file was only partially uploaded. Please try again.
podcast-texts.image-upload-dir-not-writable: Image upload failed: the upload folder is not writable.
podcast-texts.image-upload-too-large: Image file is larger than {limit} MB (setting “Max. upload size”).
podcast-texts.image-upload-bad-extension: Image file has an extension that is not allowed. Allowed: {allowed}.
podcast-texts.image-upload-content-mismatch: The content of the image file does not match the extension .{ext}.
podcast-texts.audio-upload-ini-size: Audio file too large (server limit: {limit}). Please choose a smaller file or use a URL.
podcast-texts.audio-upload-form-size: Audio file exceeds the form limit.
podcast-texts.audio-upload-partial: Audio file was only partially uploaded. Please try again.
podcast-texts.audio-upload-dir-not-writable: Audio upload failed: the upload folder is not writable.
podcast-texts.audio-upload-too-large: Audio file is larger than {limit} MB (setting “Max. upload size”).
podcast-texts.audio-upload-bad-extension: Audio file has an extension that is not allowed. Allowed: {allowed}.
podcast-texts.audio-upload-content-mismatch: The content of the audio file does not match the extension .{ext}.
podcast-texts.upload-no-tmp-dir: Server configuration error: no temporary directory.
podcast-texts.upload-cant-write: Server configuration error: the file could not be written.
podcast-texts.upload-blocked: Upload blocked by the server configuration.
podcast-texts.upload-move-failed: Upload failed: the file could not be saved.
podcast-texts.upload-no-fileinfo: Upload not possible: the PHP extension “fileinfo” is missing on the server.
podcast-texts.remote-no-curl: The PHP extension curl is missing on the server.
podcast-texts.remote-no-length: The server does not report a file size.
podcast-texts.remote-not-http: The address must start with http:// or https://.
podcast-texts.remote-credentials: Addresses with credentials are not queried.
podcast-texts.remote-ports: Only the standard ports 80 and 443 are queried.
podcast-texts.remote-unresolvable: The server name cannot be resolved.
podcast-texts.remote-internal: The address points to an internal network and is not queried.
podcast-texts.remote-unreachable: The server is unreachable (connection error or timeout).
podcast-texts.js-error-audio-url: Please enter an audio URL or upload a file.
podcast-texts.js-error-date: Please enter a valid publication date.
podcast-texts.js-file-too-large: The file “{name}” ({size}) is larger than the upload limit of {limit}.
podcast-texts.js-files-too-large: Audio and image together ({size}) exceed the server limit of {limit}. Please upload them one at a time or use a URL.
podcast-texts.js-cover-too-large: The file is larger than the upload limit of {limit}.
podcast-texts.js-cover-uploaded: Uploaded and checked. Click “Save” above to apply.
podcast-texts.js-session-expired: Session expired or security token invalid. Please log in again and try once more.
podcast-texts.js-request-too-large: The request is too large for the web server (HTTP 413). Please use a smaller file or an audio URL; the limit is set by the server configuration (e.g. LimitRequestBody for Apache, client_max_body_size for Nginx).
podcast-texts.js-server-error: Server error (HTTP {status}). Details are in the Bludit or PHP error log.
podcast-texts.js-unexpected-response: Unexpected response from the server. Please reload the page and try again.
